headline: Argentina Posts Record Trade Surplus Exceeding $3 Billion in October
summary: Argentina's monthly trade surplus topped $3 billion in October, near historical highs, as export volumes reached a new record while imports showed a modest monthly rebound.
why: Trade surpluses are critical for Argentina to rebuild Central Bank foreign exchange reserves and meet sovereign external commitments.

entities.name: Banco Central de la República Argentina

impacts.name: Argentine Peso
impacts.why: A trade surplus above $3 billion provides essential hard-currency inflows to the central bank.
